sections.text: Schedule and Aid Programs 2026-2027
# Charlotte Catholic High School — Financial Aid & Tuition (Schedule and Aid Programs 2026-2027)
**Provenance**

- **Compiled by:** Claude Code deep research pass (`/implement add-charlotte-catholic`).
- **Date compiled:** 2026-08-18
- **Method:** Tuition and fee figures fetched directly from the **MACS** tuition and
 affordability page — **not** from the CCHS site, which does not publish tuition. Every
 figure below is quoted as published. Two well-known wrong sources were checked and
 rejected; both are documented under the warnings.
- **School:** Charlotte Catholic High School, grades 9–12, part of **Mecklenburg Area
 Catholic Schools (MACS)**, Diocese of Charlotte.
### ⚠️ Tuition is set centrally by MACS, not by the school

Unlike every independent school on this roster, CCHS does not set or publish its own
tuition. **MACS publishes one high-school schedule covering grades 9–12** at
discovermacs.org, and the school site links to it. That is why the source below is a
diocesan page rather than a school page.
### Source URLs
### Tuition 2026-2027, grades 9–12

**The parishioner / non-parishioner split is a tuition structure no other school on this
roster shows.** A participating Catholic family pays **$6,521 less** than a community-rate
family for the same seat — a ~30% difference driven by parish participation rather than by
financial need. The app's `top-tuition` row uses the **$23,562** International rate as the
school's highest published tier, consistent with how that row is defined for other schools.
### Financial aid mechanisms

- **Family Individualized Tuition (FIT)** — the need-based program. Awards vary by family
 circumstance and fund availability.
- **Clarity** is the need-assessment application. ⚠️ **Not FACTS and not TADS** — FACTS
 appears in this system only as the **payment processor**, which is an easy
 mis-attribution. The Clarity application carries a **$65** fee.
- **Multi-child discounts** (participating Catholic families only): **2nd child 10%** ·
 **3rd child 25%** · **4th child 50%** · **5th and additional children 100%**.
- **NC Opportunity Scholarship Program (OSP)** — awards up to **$7,000+** annually, with
 **no income cap**.
- **Education Student Accounts (ESA+)** — **$9,000** or **$17,000** yearly for students with
 qualifying disabilities.
### Deadlines

- **FIT applications: May 15** for returning students; new families are encouraged to apply
 alongside the admission application.
- **NCSEAA scholarship applications open in February** for the following school year.
- **2026-27 enrollment opens 3/23/26.**
### ⚠️ Two sources that are wrong, and are deliberately not ingested

1. **PrivateSchoolReview lists CCHS tuition as $45,000.** That is **demonstrably wrong** —
 more than double the official community rate of $21,562 published by MACS itself. Not
 used.
2. **The CCHS page titled "Financial Aid and Scholarships" is about COLLEGE financial aid
 for seniors** (FAFSA, college scholarship search), **not** CCHS tuition assistance. It
 is an easy mis-ingest for a page with that exact title, and it is not the source of
 anything here.
### Confirmed structural nulls

- **`pct-aid`, `aid-awarded`, `avg-award` — permanently null.** MACS publishes aid figures
 **diocese-wide only**, never per school. There is no CCHS-specific percentage of students
 on aid, total aid awarded, or average award anywhere in the published record.
- **No Form 990 exists, structurally.** MACS operates under **EIN 56-1779865**, and
 ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer states the organization "is not required to submit tax
 filings because the IRS designates it as a **religious organization**." **This is a
 permanent null, not a research gap** — no future pass will find a 990, and none should be
 spent looking. `hickory-grove-christian` already ships this same shape in the app.
- **`tuition-history` — not published.** MACS publishes only the **current** year's
 schedule. Secondary sources give conflicting older figures ($13,348 and $9,366) with no
 reliable year attribution; **those are not shipped**, because a tuition-history row built
 from unattributable figures is worse than no row. Archived MACS snapshots would be the
 path if this row is ever wanted.
Fees

Note the capital fee is charged **per family**, not per student — so it does not scale with
the number of children enrolled, unlike the application and enrollment fees.
Sources referenced across these documents

- https://catholicnewsherald.com/schools/94-news/schools/11321-apply-now-for-2025-26-opportunity-scholarships
- https://www.discovermacs.org/admissions/tuitionandaffordability

Additional snapshots checked that carried the same figures (redundant confirmations):
`20241013110721` (2024–25), `20250213060926` (2024–25), `20250713082444` (2025–26).
sections.t: Ulteriori istantanee verificate che riportavano le stesse cifre (conferme ridondanti): `20241013110721` (2024–25), `20250213060926` (2024–25), `20250713082444` (2025–26).

sections.text: Note on the published 5.0% increase
sections.t: Nota sull’aumento pubblicato del 5.0%

sections.text:
The school states that every band rose 5.0% from 2025–26 to 2026–27. The archived
2025–26 figures are close to, but **not identical to**, what a naive 2026–27 ÷ 1.05
calculation would produce — the school rounds each band to a clean figure. Examples:
sections.t: La scuola dichiara che ogni fascia è aumentata del 5.0% dal 2025–26 al 2026–27. Le cifre archiviate del 2025–26 sono vicine a — ma **non identiche a** — quanto produrrebbe un semplice calcolo 2026–27 ÷ 1.05: la scuola arrotonda ogni fascia a una cifra tonda. Esempi:

sections.text:
This confirms the school's "5.0%" claim is accurate to rounding, and it validates using
the real published figures rather than the derived ones in any year-over-year chart.
sections.t: Ciò conferma che l’affermazione della scuola del “5.0%” è accurata a meno dell’arrotondamento, e convalida l’uso delle cifre effettivamente pubblicate anziché di quelle derivate in qualsiasi grafico anno su anno.

sections.text: ### The year-pinning decision
sections.t: ### La decisione di fissare l’anno

sections.text:
**The app uses 2026-27 ($22,790, grades 9-12)** for `top-tuition` and every
tuition figure in prose, matching the 2026-27 basis used for the six existing
schools. The 2025-26 figures above exist so a reader reconciling against the
payment-terms PDF understands the two live years; no app figure mixes years.
sections.t:
**L’app usa il 2026-27 ($22,790, grades 9-12)** per `top-tuition` e ogni
cifra di retta nella prosa, in linea con la base 2026-27 usata per le sei scuole
esistenti. Le cifre 2025-26 qui sopra esistono affinché un lettore che effettui una riconciliazione rispetto al
PDF delle condizioni di pagamento comprenda i due anni attivi; nessuna cifra dell’app mescola gli anni.

 the full cost of tuition at Davidson Day School. Families receiving the 'maximum' award
 at Davidson Day are required to pay $3,000 per year, per student for tuition." The same

sections.text:
**Note on the published "total".** Gaston Day publishes tuition and fees as separate columns
plus an explicit combined total. The Upper School sticker figure is therefore **$22,390**
(tuition $20,215 + fees $2,175) — that combined figure is what third-party sites quote as
the school's tuition, and it is the like-for-like number against other schools' all-in
figures.
sections.t:
**Nota sul “totale” pubblicato.** Gaston Day pubblica rette e costi accessori come colonne separate
più un totale combinato esplicito. La cifra di listino dell’Upper School è quindi **$22,390**
(retta $20,215 + costi accessori $2,175) — quel totale combinato è ciò che i siti terzi citano come
retta della scuola, ed è il numero confrontabile alla pari con le cifre onnicomprensive delle altre scuole.

sections.text:

the cost page; the per-grade 2026-27 schedule PDF was not posted at the time of this pass.
sections.t:

sections.text: After school & enrichment rates
sections.t: Tariffe del doposcuola e delle attività di arricchimento

sections.text:
**Rate conflict with the after-school web page — recorded, not silently resolved.** The
`/afterschoolprogram/` page states hours of **3:15 PM – 5:30 PM** and prices of
**$100/month** (Lower School) and **$60/month** (Middle School), with drop-in at $30/day and
$15/day. The tuition schedule (S1) states **3:00–6:00** / **4:00–6:00** at **$95/week** and
**$55/week**, with the same $30/day and $15/day drop-in rates.
sections.t:
**Conflitto di tariffe con la pagina web del doposcuola — registrato, non risolto silenziosamente.** La
pagina `/afterschoolprogram/` indica un orario **3:15 PM – 5:30 PM** e prezzi di
**$100/mese** (Lower School) e **$60/mese** (Middle School), con ingresso occasionale a $30/giorno e
$15/giorno. Lo schema delle rette (S1) indica **3:00–6:00** / **4:00–6:00** a **$95/settimana** e
**$55/settimana**, con le stesse tariffe occasionali di $30/giorno e $15/giorno.

sections.text:
The drop-in rates agree exactly across both sources. The weekly-vs-monthly labels do not:
$100/**month** for daily aftercare would be far below $30/day drop-in economics and below the
schedule's own $95/week, so the page's "/month" reads as a label error for a weekly rate.
Both sources are retained above; the app uses the **official tuition schedule (S1)** as the
rate authority and the **web page (S2/after-school file)** for the current operating window,
which is the more likely thing to have been updated in-year. See the after-school file for
the full page transcription.
sections.t:
Le tariffe occasionali coincidono esattamente tra le due fonti. Le etichette settimanale-contro-mensile no:
$100/**mese** per un doposcuola quotidiano sarebbe ben al di sotto dell’economia di un ingresso a $30/giorno e al di sotto dei
$95/settimana dello schema stesso, per cui il “/month” della pagina si legge come un errore di etichetta per una tariffa settimanale.
Entrambe le fonti sono conservate qui sopra; l’app usa lo **schema ufficiale delle rette (S1)** come
autorità sulle tariffe e la **pagina web (S2/file del doposcuola)** per la fascia oraria attualmente in vigore,
che è la cosa più probabilmente aggiornata in corso d’anno. Vedi il file del doposcuola per
la trascrizione completa della pagina.

sections.text: Financial aid
sections.t: Aiuti finanziari

sections.text:
- **Platform: Clarity** (not FACTS or SSS). Five steps: sign up at the Clarity app; add
 Gaston Day School to the applicant entry; complete the application and pay the **$65**
 fee; complete tax verification (IRS transfer or Clarity's option); submit and monitor the
 dashboard for document requests.
- **Deadline: rolling** — "The financial aid deadline is rolling, but funds may become
 limited or unavailable towards the beginning of the new school year (August)."
- **Three assistance channels:** need-based Financial Aid, Merit Scholarships, and the
 **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship**.
- **Discount ceiling: up to 80%** of tuition (Kindergarten–Grade 12).
- **Contact:** Kevin Napp, Director of Admissions, 704.864.7744 ext. 414.
sections.t:
- **Piattaforma: Clarity** (non FACTS né SSS). Cinque passaggi: registrarsi sull’app Clarity; aggiungere
 Gaston Day School alla scheda del richiedente; completare la domanda e pagare la commissione di **$65**;
 completare la verifica fiscale (trasferimento IRS o l’opzione di Clarity); inviare e monitorare la
 dashboard per eventuali richieste di documenti.
- **Scadenza: continua (rolling)** — “The financial aid deadline is rolling, but funds may become
 limited or unavailable towards the beginning of the new school year (August).”
- **Tre canali di sostegno:** aiuti finanziari basati sul bisogno, borse di merito e la
 **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship**.
- **Tetto massimo di sconto: fino all’80%** della retta (Kindergarten–Grade 12).
- **Contatto:** Kevin Napp, Director of Admissions, 704.864.7744 int. 414.

sections.text:
**Not published** on any page found in this pass: the total aid budget in dollars, the
average award, the number of families receiving aid, sibling discounts, tuition-insurance
or refund-plan terms, and the payment-plan tiers (S1 states only that "Gaston Day offers a
variety of payment plans" and that all plans assume the tuition deposit and fees have been
paid). These are recorded as confirmed absences, not as unresearched gaps.
sections.t:
**Non pubblicati** in nessuna pagina trovata in questa rilevazione: il budget complessivo degli aiuti in dollari, l’
importo medio, il numero di famiglie che ricevono aiuti, gli sconti per fratelli, i termini dell’assicurazione sulla retta
o dei piani di rimborso e le fasce dei piani di pagamento (S1 afferma soltanto che “Gaston Day offers a
variety of payment plans” e che tutti i piani presuppongono che il deposito sulla retta e i costi accessori siano stati
pagati). Sono registrate come assenze confermate, non come lacune non ricercate.

sections.text: **26% of the student body receives tuition assistance** (2025-26 Academic Profile).
sections.t: **Il 26% del corpo studentesco riceve un’assistenza sulla retta** (Academic Profile 2025-26).

sections.text:
S5 (Private School Review) reports **45%**. The school's own profile is used. The two are
also not measuring the same quantity: the profile's "tuition assistance" is need-based aid,
while a third-party "percent on financial aid" figure commonly folds in merit awards and
state Opportunity Scholarship recipients — which at Gaston Day are three separate channels
(S2). The gap is therefore plausibly definitional rather than either figure being wrong.
sections.t:
S5 (Private School Review) riporta il **45%**. Si usa il profilo della scuola stessa. Le due cifre
non misurano nemmeno la stessa grandezza: la “tuition assistance” del profilo è aiuto basato sul bisogno,
mentre una percentuale di terze parti “percent on financial aid” include comunemente anche le borse di merito e i
beneficiari della Opportunity Scholarship statale — che a Gaston Day sono tre canali distinti
(S2). Lo scarto è quindi plausibilmente definitorio, più che indicare che una delle due cifre sia sbagliata.
